domain_title: Purpose, value, context, roles and classification
title: Undefined or elastic intended purpose
canonical_definition: The system has a materially ambiguous, conflicting or incomplete use boundary, or its reachable use expands without requalification and accountable authorization.
failure_mechanism: Teams use different definitions of the approved task, audience or decision. Later changes to a feature, integration or workflow can broaden what the system does before anyone reevaluates whom it affects or authorizes the expanded use.
potential_consequences: People or decisions outside the reviewed scope become exposed to system outputs.
Two teams apply incompatible boundaries to the same workflow.
Operational use continues after a material expansion without evidence that the wider use was assessed.

conditions: Assess the declared, reachable and observed use of the AI-enabled workflow, including bounded experiments and externally supplied components in context.
Include indirect affected groups, downstream outputs and changes since the last authorization. State which paths and periods could be evaluated.

primary_questions.question: Is the declared purpose vague, inconsistent or missing material use boundaries?
Do implemented or operational uses materially diverge from the declared purpose?
Has a scoped current comparison tested declared and actual uses for divergence?

atomic_tests.test: Compare current authoritative purpose records for the same version. Identify conflicts that change the permitted task, audience, operating context or accountable decision.
Check whether the stated purpose identifies an assessable use and decision, or leaves scope open through generic feature or product descriptions.
Compare the documented audience and affected groups with the actual workflow. Look for omitted groups whose exposure would materially change the assessment.
Check whether declared use rules distinguish representative permitted, prohibited and foreseeable misuse cases. Compare those rules with the result of executed boundary checks.
Trace an output to its consumers and permitted decisions. Identify whether current records leave material downstream action or authority open-ended.
Compare the approved boundary with reachable access, data, features, integrated actions, administrative roles and fallback paths for the assessed release.
Review executed cases for permitted and out-of-scope use. Determine whether results show a material difference from the declared controls and document the scope covered.
Trace when materially expanded uses became reachable or were observed against when impact review, reassessment and authorization occurred.
Determine whether a scoped, current, executed and independently verified comparison covered all material failure mechanisms for this use, and record remaining gaps.

antipattern_indicators: Prototype features become accepted use without review

required_evidence.title: Purpose records and reconciliation
required_evidence.description: Compare the effective registration, product and operational records by version and authority. Document which conflicts would change actual decisions and which were resolved by an authorized superseding record.

required_evidence.title: Declared versus reachable use
required_evidence.description: Map effective roles, features, workflows, integrations and outputs to the authorized scope. Distinguish reachable paths from disabled or demonstrably isolated ones.

required_evidence.title: Executed use-boundary comparison
required_evidence.description: Record expected and observed results for permitted and out-of-scope cases, with release, environment, result and limitations. Cover foreseeable misuse relevant to the assessed use.

required_evidence.title: Change and authorization chronology
required_evidence.description: Match the first evidence of activation or expanded usage to impact review, reassessment and authorization dates. State the period covered and disclose any gaps.

required_evidence.title: Audience and downstream exposure review
required_evidence.description: Compare the declared roles and affected groups with the specific workflow and output consumers. Record who would be affected by an omitted pathway and why it matters.

required_evidence.title: Independent scoped absence evaluation
required_evidence.description: Keep the assessed version, scope, authoritative records, executed cases, chronology, observations, results and independent reviewer decision. Record residual blind spots explicitly.

sufficiency: Use attributable evidence to support presence. A verified incompatible scope decision, reachable divergence or observed unauthorized expansion can establish a specific mechanism within its evidenced scope.
Preserve materially conflicting records and use UNKNOWN where the operative boundary or the difference is unresolved. Escalate material interpretation conflicts to the accountable owner.

Reserve TESTED_ABSENT for a current, successful, independently verified evaluation covering all material mechanisms. A blind spot on any material pathway keeps the object UNKNOWN unless qualified presence is independently supported.
Re-evaluate affected paths after a material change to the release, user population, data use, integrations or downstream decisions.
evidence_rules.evidence_ceiling: Document review can establish ambiguity or a conflict in declared scope. Implementation review can establish reachable divergence. Operating records can establish observed expansion for their covered period. Tested absence requires the full absence contract.
false_positive_guards: Check whether different wording points to the same controlled boundary before treating it as a conflict.
Distinguish a generic underlying model from the bounded application in which people can actually use it.
Check whether a release changed reachable users, decisions, data or effects before calling it scope expansion.
prohibited_inferences: A weak or unknown A1 result alone cannot establish AP-A1 presence.
Silence, missing incident reports and a planned evaluation cannot establish TESTED_ABSENT.
A release date or technical flag alone cannot establish authorized expansion.
AP-A1 presence alone cannot establish a legal conclusion.

required_artifacts: Versioned purpose records and reconciliation of conflicting definitions
Comparison of declared, reachable and observed use, including affected people and downstream decisions
Executed representative permitted-use, prohibited-use and foreseeable-misuse cases with expected and observed results
Chronology of material changes and governing decisions for the observation period
Independent review recording scope, result and limitations for each material failure mechanism

conditions: Refer for a block on consequential deployment or material expansion where verified AP-A1 presence affects the operating boundary.
Refer unresolved material scope conflicts to governance for a decision on an evidenced constrained scope before progression.

normative_source_mappings.relevant_locator: NIST AI 100-1, MAP 1.1 (PDF p. 31), MAP 3.3 (PDF p. 32), MANAGE 2.4 (PDF p. 37)
normative_source_mappings.mapping_rationale: This voluntary framework supports checking documented context and application scope against current use and considering disengagement for outcomes inconsistent with intended use. SAE defines the anti-pattern and its absence-test criteria.

finding_definitions.title: Purpose is vague, general-purpose or technically framed without a testable decision context
Purpose statements conflict or omit material users, affected persons, permitted or prohibited uses
Reachable implementation or operations exceed the approved purpose boundary
Purpose or use scope expanded without requalification and authorization
Absence of undefined or elastic purpose is not established by a scoped current test
